experiment_template.research_question: Does useful bounded evidence state improve final relevant-context selection and post-displacement use at equal total-model-token budgets?
stop_conditions: No live run before G source, protocol, exposure, token and verification bindings.
No threshold changes, replacements or in-cohort tuning after outcome observation.

records.falsifier: No preregistered final-span F1 gain at equal total-token caps, or precision/coverage degradation, on exposed pressure cases.
records.mechanism: Keep confirmed evidence identities and exact retrieval handles across displacement; expose only relevant bounded state for continuation.
records.scope: ContextBench full pinned scope; development and reserved confirmation separated. Candidate hypothesis; live execution unbound.
records.statement: Source-bound delivered-evidence state improves final relevant context under small-window pressure.

records.research_question: With complete source-version feedback, pending delivery and bounded finalization, does the evidence index improve final relevant-context selection under GLM small-window pressure?
stop_conditions: No selection or acceptance threshold changes based on this round.
No within-round changes, replacements or source refresh.
Pause unstarted cells on shared provider or instrument failure, retain all attempted outcomes.
Report missing/empty final selections and unknown usage explicitly.

success_criteria.analysis: Paired native metrics and cumulative model tokens with complete missingness; no independent H5/H6 or semantic retention claim
success_criteria.coverage: Every scheduled ID accounted; unstarted-paused distinct from attempted failure
success_criteria.scope: 16-cell development diagnostic at 8K only; no confirmation or clearance

records.claim: Six attempted cells yielded five context-budget stops and one explicit empty final selection; no native scores or complete scored pair. Ten unstarted cells were paused after verifying a shared oversized-tool-response recovery gap.
limitations: Lower consumed tokens are not an improvement when episodes terminate early.
No causal H1, H5 or H6 benefit/failure can be estimated from these unscored outcomes.
Pending tool exchanges were retained rather than silently discarded, but oversized results ended the episode before actionable feedback could reach the model.
The stopped run and all prior development exposure remain recorded.

records.next_action: Select and test a bounded response-admission/recovery contract that returns truthful actionable deferral or paging feedback without marking unseen source as delivered; freeze a new matched experiment after continuity review.
